title: Home guide: squeezing bottles
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 26 (Home practical guide and safety card: squeezing bottles (portal worksheet; over a sink))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Compare how easily a gas and a liquid can be squashed.
equipment: An empty plastic bottle with a lid
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put the lid on the empty bottle and squeeze it. Does it squash?
Fill the bottle to the top with water and put the lid on tightly.
Squeeze it over the sink. Does it squash now?
